prompt_en: Create a vertical photorealistic cinematic fashion photograph of an unmistakably adult woman fighter pilot who walks toward the camera carrying her flight helmet on a wide military runway at golden hour. A parked KF-21 fighter jet dominates the background, its angular gray fuselage, twin canted tails, and twin-engine geometry clearly recognizable. Use Image 1 as the sole identity source, her facial identity closely matching the supplied portrait reference; retain her natural almond-shaped brown eyes and spacing, softly oval adult face length, lower-face and jaw width, cheekbones, nose, lips, skin texture, hairline, and natural asymmetry. Frame it as a sensual high-fashion aviation editorial: a precisely fitted olive flight suit, upper zipper lowered to a fitted black base-layer neckline, sleeves at the forearms, a self-directed confident stride, steady direct gaze, and long dark wavy hair lifted by runway wind. Use a slightly low full-body 35mm environmental view, keeping her face clear and the aircraft imposing. Warm rim light catches her hair and suit seams; cool metallic jet reflections, runway heat shimmer, authentic fabric wear, and realistic aviation scale complete the frame.
negative_en: excessive HDR, plastic-looking skin, illustration look, unrealistic hands, broken facial features, cartoon style, 3D render look, fake-looking background
